name: tb-vga
title: Thunderbolt VGA (Display1 / KMS)
description: Hot-pluggable stdvga/Bochs-compatible display adapter (PCI 1234:1111). Its scanout is exported over org.qemu.Display1 (QSM Direct) and can be shown on a real monitor through DRM/KMS.

args.name: vram
args.label: VRAM (MiB)
args.hint: power of two; Linux wants 2x the frame size (16 for 1280x800, 128 for 3840x2400)

args.name: edid
args.label: EDID file
args.hint: empty: the connected display's EDID, or the built-in 1280x800
